description: This file defines a StatefulWidget 'HomeShell' which manages a bottom navigation bar with four screens: Home, Cart, History, and Profile. It orchestrates navigation among these screens in a Flutter app.

classes.name: HomeShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides the main shell for navigating between different sections of the app using a bottom navigation bar.

classes.name: _HomeShellState
classes.description: The state class for HomeShell, managing the current index of the selected bottom navigation item and the associated screen widgets.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, rendering the Scaffold with the current selected screen and bottom navigation bar.
